title: 第1605章 桑蚕岛第1604章 老贼
content_zh:
桑蚕岛，在整个混乱之地，算是比较特殊的，岛上不养奴隶，不养牲口。
平时很少参与混乱之地修仙界的争斗。
岛上居民，大部分都是女修为主，专门种植桑树，养蚕，卖丝，卖布为生。
就在今日，平静的桑蚕岛上空，飞来一道白色的狼狈人影。
这道人影，正是全力逃跑的同贵。
他借助那一颗劫雷珠的威能，一口气逃出数十里外，暂时摆脱了追踪。
此刻逃到桑蚕岛的上空，发现这座岛屿风景优美，异常的宁静安详。
他当即身形一动，化为一道流光，投入到桑蚕岛上。
同贵刚落到地上，就有一名采桑女修，提着一篮桑葚上前查看。
“这位道友，桑蚕岛内部，不留外客，还请见谅！”
女子见同贵神态狼狈，身上还有伤，便心生怜悯，说话也显得格外客气礼貌。
“道友若有借住需求，可前往外部待客处，那边有专门接待安置外地道友的房屋。”
“我这就领你过去！”
采桑女子指着岛外围的一片建筑群，便要领着同贵去那边借住。
“这是我们岛上特产的千年桑葚果，你可以尝尝，酸酸甜甜，味道很好的。”
采桑女笑起来，露出两颗洁白小巧的獠牙，同时她将手里的竹篮，递给同贵，请他吃。
但就在此刻，同贵突然出手，一掌就抓住了采桑女子的脖子。
一股强大的神识，涌入采桑女子的识海之中。
搜魂秘术施展开。
采桑女子所有的记忆，全都被他查阅了一遍。

片刻过后，随手将女子往地上一扔。
采桑女已经瘫软在地上，手脚抖动，眼睛迷茫地看着他。
她大概到现在还没弄明白，对方为什么对自己出手？
同贵捋着他仅剩的几根胡子，心中思索，整理刚才得到的信息。
另一只手，随手打出一个小火球，落到采桑女身上，火焰蓬地一下升起。
采桑女在火焰中挣扎了两三下，只过了几息，已经化为一点点白色的灰烬。
同贵袖子一扫，将那点残存的灰烬扫进草丛之中。
接着他的身形开始变形，很快就变成了采桑女的模样，提起地上的竹篮，往一处房屋走去。
连续几年的奔逃，身上积攒了不少的伤势，此地安静，正好适合他养伤……
三天后，禾叶率领灵鹫仙君府的高手，追到了桑蚕岛上空。
“确定在这里吗？”
禾叶回头，向身后一人问道。
“确定，那股气息就停留在岛上，但具体位置，不太好判定。”
身后一名修士，手里抱着一只青色老鼠。
content_en:
Silkworm Island is quite special in the entire chaotic land. It does not raise slaves or livestock on the island.
He rarely participates in the battles in the world of immortality in the chaotic land.
Most of the residents on the island are female nuns, who specialize in planting mulberry trees, raising silkworms, and selling silk and cloth to make a living.
Just today, a white and embarrassed figure flew over the peaceful Silkworm Island.
This figure was none other than Tonggui who was running away with all his strength.
With the help of the power of the thunder bead, he escaped dozens of miles away in one breath, temporarily getting rid of tracking.
At this moment, I escaped to the sky above Sangcan Island and found that this island has beautiful scenery and is unusually peaceful and peaceful.
He immediately moved and turned into a stream of light, falling onto Silkworm Island.
As soon as Tonggui landed on the ground, a female mulberry-picking nun came forward to check with a basket of mulberries.
"Fellow Taoist, no outsiders are allowed inside Sangcan Island, please forgive me!"
When the woman saw that Tonggui looked embarrassed and had wounds on his body, she felt pity and spoke very politely.
"If fellow Taoists need accommodation, they can go to the external reception area, where there is a house specially designed to receive and accommodate fellow Taoists from other places."
"I'll lead you there right now!"
The mulberry-picking woman pointed to a group of buildings on the outskirts of the island, and wanted to take her companion to stay there.
"This is the thousand-year-old mulberry fruit that is a specialty of our island. You can try it. It is sweet and sour and tastes very good."
The mulberry picking girl smiled, showing two small white fangs. At the same time, she handed the bamboo basket in her hand to Tong Gui and asked him to eat.
But at this moment, Tonggui suddenly took action and grabbed the mulberry picking woman's neck with one palm.
A powerful spiritual consciousness poured into the sea of ​​consciousness of the mulberry-picking woman.
The soul-searching secret technique was launched.
All the memories of the mulberry-picking woman were reviewed by him.
After a moment, he casually threw the woman to the ground.
The mulberry picking girl had collapsed on the ground, her hands and feet trembling, and her eyes were looking at him in confusion.
She probably still hasn't figured out why the other party attacked her?
Tonggui stroked the few remaining beards he had left, thinking in his mind and sorting out the information he had just received.
With the other hand, he casually shot a small fireball, which fell on the mulberry picking girl, and the flames suddenly rose.
The mulberry picking girl struggled two or three times in the flames. After only a few breaths, she had turned into a little bit of white ashes.
Tonggui swept his sleeves and swept the remaining ashes into the grass.
Then his body began to deform, and soon he turned into the appearance of a mulberry picking girl. He picked up the bamboo basket on the ground and walked towards a house.
After years of running away, he had accumulated a lot of injuries. This quiet place was just right for him to recuperate...
Three days later, He Ye led the masters from the Lingjiu Immortal Lord's Mansion to catch up to the sky above Mulberry Silkworm Island.
"Are you sure you're here?"
Heye turned around and asked the person behind him.
"I'm sure, that aura stays on the island, but the exact location is hard to determine."
There is a monk behind him, holding a blue mouse in his hand.
